spec.description:
Retrieve information about ledger entries. 50 results are returned at a time, the most recent by default.

**Note on Staking/Earn assets:** assets migrated from the legacy Staking system to the new Earn system may appear with symbol extensions -- `.B` (new yield-bearing products), `.F` (auto-earning Kraken Rewards) -- these are read-only for transacting; use the base asset instead.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Data - Query ledger entries`

asset.description: Filter output by asset, or a comma-delimited list of assets.

type.description: Type of ledger entries to retrieve.

start.description: Starting unix timestamp or ledger ID of results (exclusive).

end.description: Ending unix timestamp or ledger ID of results (inclusive).

without_count.description: If true, does not retrieve the count of ledger entries. Request can be noticeably faster for users with many ledger entries, as this avoids an extra database query.

rebase_multiplier.description: Optional parameter for viewing xstocks data. `rebased` displays in terms of underlying equity, `base` displays in terms of SPV tokens.

ledger.description: Ledger entries, keyed by ledger ID.

refid.description: Reference ID of the parent transaction (trade, deposit, withdrawal, etc.) that caused the ledger entry.

time.description: Unix timestamp of the ledger entry.

subtype.description: Additional info relating to the ledger entry type, where applicable.

count.description: Amount of available ledger info matching criteria. Omitted from the response when `without_count` is `true`.

notes: Same shape as ClosedOrders: `ofs` genuinely offsets a fixed 50-row page and `count` would terminate the walk, but no `pagination` block is declared -- an item-counted `total` (rule 7) requires a declared `size` parameter to convert the count into a page count, and Kraken exposes no parameter to set the page size here. `count` is also absent entirely when `without_count: true` is passed.
